scope: Assigned worktree only; no push, deployment, model review or live checkpoint changes.
cause: A retained old-generation settlement_gap bypassed the probe and froze the account as probe_failed even after the server closed its run and settled its reservation. The Fable app_server_protocol failure originated in rejected model-only prestart telemetry (AEON-716 diagnosis).
fix: Expose explicit reservation settlement proof through the existing authorized run detail; close old local gaps only after local exit and matching terminal run/account/agent/order/purpose plus all reservations settled. Preserve dead letters, original generation and process provenance; retain exact retryable reports. Report unsettled_previous_run with operator guidance in lifecycle, diagnostics and existing UI.

fix_round_2.cause: A nested 5s GetRun timeout was passed through pollContextError, so context.DeadlineExceeded aborted the whole poll while the 20s parent context was still live. Other accounts were not probed, queued work was not dispatched, and unsettled_previous_run was not reported.
fix_round_2.fix: On GetRun failure, return errSettlementParked joined only with the parent context error. The child timeout is not a poll deadline. The account still freezes through freezePreviousRun and the gap is read again on the next poll.
fix_round_2.regression: TestSettlementReadTimeoutDoesNotAbortLivePoll failed on 05c5cb2f with a live parent and context.DeadlineExceeded, then passed after the fix together with the existing settlement and poll-context tests.
fix_round_2.left_non_blocking: Old-generation gaps whose local state is not completed, failed, or cancelled stay unread. An existing harness, pin, or profile block can still be reported ahead of unsettled_previous_run.
